name: Seachem Flourish Potassium
description: Liquid potassium supplement (potassium sulphate solution). Seachem does not publish a per-dose ppm, so values are NOT disclosed — qualitative `affects` only.
notes: Label dose ~5 ml per 125 L. Potassium is the macro most often limiting in fish-fed tanks (food supplies N + P but little K).
